notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.notes:
- Changed default binding of Air Brakes on the keyboard from A/D keys to left/right arrows. Steering moved from left/right arrows to A/D keys. If you preferred previous settings, you can change back your key bindings in game Options/Controls menu.
- changed the way of saving the campaign - now you can change ships and weapons between races in the tournament (after going back to the menu)
- added the option to abandon the tournament
- the number of points needed to unlock ships has been reduced
- the number of points needed to unlock weapons utilities and counters has been reduced
- sound fixes
- big localization fixes for French, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese and Spanish
- graphic fixes on Buried Temple
- optimization improvements

notes.title: FLASHOUT 3: Demo Version Updated - VR support added & more!
notes.notes:
Hello all FLASHOUT fans!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6106540/5c0dcc32c2114159e6b1479782654d88882756ec.gif

As promised in our latest announcement, in order to celebrate the Steam VR Fest starting today, we have added VR support to the demo version! But that's not all!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/b1d2352b211c86c65448b194b40417aa49821a49.gif

In the case of VR all you need to do is start the game in VR mode (just make sure your VR headset is turned on). If you need to recenter the camera, press the right analog stick on your gamepad. We really do hope you will enjoy the action in virtual reality, as in our opinion it is really exciting and makes the heart beat faster!

But that's not all we have prepared. In order to be sure VR works properly, we needed to optimize the game and we wanted the standard version to profit from it. Thus, the demo version also got updated in this regard and the graphics were improved and what happens on the screen is now more readable, but also the framerates got better.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/0e2dabcee6ed6555ad28b7e9344a170f9d95524d.gif

Last but not least, the cockpit view (even though not final) is now also present in the standard version (press the "Select" button on your gamepad to change the camera view). Tip: you can turn on or turn off the body in the gameplay options.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/fb8094138c9475bd1351fee372be5344b7a43c88.gif

Hope you will be happy with the update and stay tuned for more FLASHOUT 3 news!
